data.additional_information:
P&G India is excited to extend an off-campus placement opportunity to your M.Sc, M.Tech and PhD student cohort for a role within our Research & Development organization. As a global leader in consumer goods, P&G is dedicated to delivering superior propositions to consumers worldwide, and R&D plays a crucial role in driving such innovation.

We are seeking passionate and talented individuals with in-depth technical mastery and sharp learning agility to develop groundbreaking solutions that can win the hearts and minds of the Indian consumer. This role offers an incredible opportunity to contribute to consumer research and product development across the region, from idea inception to in-market monitoring.

We believe that IISc graduates possess the exceptional talent and rigorous academic background to thrive in this challenging and rewarding environment. Further details may be found on the application page.
